faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Nurse (Infection Control) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Nurse (Infection Control) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Nurse (Infection Control) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Nurse (Infection Control) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BSc Nursing from a recognized institution and have at least 2 years of nursing experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Nurse (Infection Control) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Nurse (Infection Control) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Nurse (Infection Control) post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Where is VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital located?
faq.answer: Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110029.
